role_agent_name: Materials Procurement and Supply Chain Lead (PROC)
abstract: Maintains deep production casing corrosion-resistant alloy procurement costs and supplier delivery agreements
system_message:
You are the Materials Procurement and Supply Chain Lead (PROC). Your business responsibility is maintaining deep production casing corrosion-resistant alloy procurement costs and supplier delivery agreements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains deep production casing corrosion-resistant alloy procurement costs and supplier delivery agreements（SUPP）
information_points.content:
PROC-SUPP-5EW：For the Multi-lateral stimulated horizontal borehole plan, the production casing procurement cost for the 9-5/8 inch chrome alloy production liner string delivered to site is 310 kEUR.
PROC-SUPP-NIC：For the Deviated doublet deep borehole plan, the production casing procurement cost for the 9-5/8 inch chrome alloy production liner string delivered to site is 410 kEUR.
PROC-SUPP-MG2：For the Cascaded tri-well vertical borehole plan, the production casing procurement cost for the 9-5/8 inch chrome alloy production liner string delivered to site is 450 kEUR.

information_points.title: Tubular manufacturing lead time（LEAD）
information_points.content:
PROC-LEAD-UQI：For the Cascaded tri-well vertical borehole plan, the seamless pipe mill lead time for custom high-strength casing batch production from order placement to port-of-entry dispatch is 18 wk.
PROC-LEAD-6SA：For the Deviated doublet deep borehole plan, the seamless pipe mill lead time for custom high-strength casing batch production from order placement to port-of-entry dispatch is 24 wk.
PROC-LEAD-F8U：For the Multi-lateral stimulated horizontal borehole plan, the seamless pipe mill lead time for custom high-strength casing batch production from order placement to port-of-entry dispatch is 12 wk.
